Bull.story: AI is a durable second S-curve. Product revenue compounds 25%/yr to about $18.5B as CoCo and CoWork pull new users and new workloads onto the platform; falling inference costs take product gross margin back to 76.5%; operating leverage lifts the non-GAAP operating margin to the mid-30s and SBC finally falls to 10.5% of revenue, so owner earnings become real money.

Base.story: The AI step-up is real but fades from 36% toward the mid-teens by FY2031. Product revenue compounds 21%/yr to about $15.7B at a 75% gross margin, the non-GAAP operating margin reaches roughly 29%, and SBC grinds down to 13.5% of revenue, the trend of the last five years extended.

Bear.story: The FY2027 acceleration was a migration burst, not a new baseline: agent traffic settles onto cheaper engines and open Iceberg storage, growth falls to 11%/yr, AI mix holds product gross margin at 71%, and SBC stays above 20% of revenue because AI talent has to be paid in stock.
